notes_for_editor: Thin record: the FFLOS register page is the only Jones-specific source. Two web searches and the cached FFLOS Pennsylvania index turned up no other Union County tower source. The register gives no coordinates, so the brief's point cannot be checked. The brief's coordinates (40.97452, -77.13886) match a TopoQuest gazetteer summit named Jones Mountain at 2,165 ft in Union County; that gazetteer does not mention a tower, so it is not cited and the summit is not confirmed as the tower site. Do not confuse with Jackie Jones Mountain in Rockland County, NY (1928 tower), a different site. The firelookout.org Pennsylvania list returned 404 in the cache. No build date, staffing, fires or site description found. Source 2 is a general statewide remark, not about this tower. Checked 2026-10-10: the story no longer glosses 'bald tower' (the register does not define the term), and the statewide remark is paraphrased rather than quoted.
